result.detail: Five seeds on a shared split and negatives: degree-matched macro/micro is 0.2897/0.2910 for the migrated graph, 0.3040/0.2679 for raw_all and 0.2803/0.2812 for ppi700; on the fair protocol 0.7672/0.7212, 0.7583/0.7115 and 0.7602/0.7149. The protocols disagree and every difference is about 0.01 against standard deviations of 0.003-0.011. Removing the disease cap is the only coverage change that clearly helps: the pre-migration core scored 0.2528/0.2672 degree-matched and 0.7113/0.6922 fair.
result.status: accepted (F-0097); coverage buys completeness, not prediction
